text:
Nora (CEO): Quick executive weekly — two things this week: (1) final go/no-go for Private GA on Friday, (2) new default data retention for request logs = 30 days (exceptions must be approved). Please read and act. :megaphone:

Evan (VP Eng): Noted. For go/no-go we need p95/p99 on the canary and confirmation that the telemetry opt-out is functionally tested. Ill schedule a canary smoke tomorrow AM.

Sana (Head of Product): Product note: communicate the 30-day retention in the release notes and the admin UI. Also include a clear opt-out UX for telemetry in the onboarding flow. Draft copy will be in the release notes doc by EOD Wed.

Riley (Head of Legal): Legal: 30 days is fine as default but we need an exception workflow for regulated customers (DSARs / retention SLAs). Please route exception requests to legal@redwood. We'll need a short sign-off stamp in the Console.

Diego (Finance): From finance perspective: we expect Private GA to start generating committed revenue early, but please add an estimate of first-month churn risk if retention opt-outs reduce observability. Put a simple sensitivity table in the cost-impact sheet.

Pri (Security): Security asks: add a retention flag to the audit log for any retention-exception approvals. Also we want an automated nightly job to validate that no logs older than 30 days remain in the live bucket (retain-only snapshots are fine). Ill share the script.

Nora (CEO): Timeline: Friday 16:00 PT is go/no-go meeting. Requestors: Evan (rollout), Sana (release notes & UX), Pri (security validation), Riley (legal OK for exceptions), Diego (revenue impact). If any of you are blocked, escalate to me ASAP.

Evan (VP Eng): OpsBot, schedule canary run and tag metrics collection for p95/p99 + cold-starts.

OpsBot: Canary scheduled by Evan at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Hooks: telemetry-optout-tests, p95/p99, cold-starts-30s. Build: 2026.04.01-rlw-202.

Sana (Head of Product): UX note: the telemetry opt-out must not break deduped error reporting. Please ensure Sentry/rollbar mappings still work when opt-out is enabled.

Pri (Security): Will validate Sentry mappings in CI. Also tagging security: we need an emergency rollback play for Private nodes with quick key-revoke steps.

Evan (VP Eng): Ill add the rollback steps to the runbook. Sam and infra will be on the playoff for canary.

Diego (Finance): Diego here  small ask: label all perf experiments in the next two weeks with cost:"metric" and revenue:"est" so finance can attribute. Example: cost:batching revenue:0.05pct.

Riley (Head of Legal): One procedural point: for any customer exceptions we need a signed amendment. Legal can template that but need lead contact from account team.

Nora (CEO): A couple of risks called out: risk A) telemetry opt-out reduces observability -> mitigations: sampling, agent-side safe-logs; risk B) 3rd-party KMS onboarding delay -> mitigations: temporary managed-key fallback with strict audit. Call out owners in the go/no-go doc.

Evan (VP Eng): Ill own the KMS fallback plan and add explicit acceptance criteria for canary (no p99 regressions > 20% vs baseline, opt-out e2e tests pass).

Sana (Head of Product): Ill own release notes + customer comms. Will post drafts in #product-docs for review.

Pri (Security): Security will run the nightly retention check and post results to #security-alerts.

Diego (Finance): Ill circulate a one-page sensitivity table with three scenarios (base / opt-out-high / opt-out-low) by Wed noon.

Riley (Head of Legal): Legal will prepare the amendment template and a short checklist for exceptions.

Nora (CEO): Thanks team. Friday 16:00 PT is decision point. Two asks before then: 1) Evan post canary metrics in this thread, 2) Sana post release notes draft. Keep messages brief in-thread so the exec meeting can be succinct. :calendar:

Evan (VP Eng): Will do. Canary run starts at 09:00 PT, will post summary by 11:30 PT.

Sana (Head of Product): Draft release notes posted to <https://confluence.redwood/releases/private-ga-draft>. Please comment.

Pri (Security): Nightly retention job draft posted to #security with logs.

Diego (Finance): Sensitivity sheet shared: <https://sheets.redwood/PrivateGA/sensitivity>.

Riley (Head of Legal): Amendment template uploaded to legal drive.

Nora (CEO): Great. Short follow-up only  if anything material changes, ping me directly. Appreciate the hustle. :sparkles:
